# Release the circular Faith Reins favicon

The browser favicon now uses a forest-green circle with transparent corners and the approved cream v7 horse artwork. Horse paths, placement and brand colors are preserved.

The shared page layout points to fresh asset URLs, `/assets/v7/site-icon-circle-64.png` and `/assets/v7/site-icon-circle.svg`, so browsers can refresh their cached square favicon. These URLs also avoid Wix's reserved `/favicon.*` responses. The PNG is a 64 × 64 fallback and the SVG is declared with `sizes="any"`.

Validation: visually inspect the SVG and PNG; confirm 64 × 64 dimensions and transparent PNG corners; build public pages and protected account runtime through the PR preview workflow; verify the production home, service, shop and account pages declare the circular icon URLs and both live assets respond with the expected artwork and MIME types.

Production target: the existing Faith Reins site, `2d8c6050-5730-4bed-9c7a-266ca7bd00b4` (`https://www.faithreins.com/`).
